items.title: Bringing AI Agents closer to SAP: What’s new in AWS for SAP MCP Server
items.summary: AI agents are only as useful as the business data and processes they can reach. SAP customers told us they needed a secure, governed way to connect AI agents to business data in their SAP landscape. Working backwards from that need, we launched the AWS for SAP MCP Server earlier this year. Powered by Amazon […]
